title: Custom API / Backend Service Database Access
summary: 研究 Supabase Edge Function 作為 backend service 存取正式 PostgreSQL objects 時的 identity、table privilege、RLS、Native Data API CRUD、RPC / PostgreSQL Function 與 transaction boundary。此題由 D-BATCH-1 的 formal place permission failure 暴露，但屬 Custom API / Backend Service Access，不屬 Cron capability。
flow: Edge Function → service identity → Native Data API CRUD / RPC → formal-style secured PostgreSQL objects. Research includes least-privilege access, RLS vs table privilege, function execution/security context, and transaction semantics required by representative Nook Works workloads.
